GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2019-11-20T16:39:48Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Escape double quote sign in CSV
Description: I have CSV file with comma as separator sign, but without quotes for column entries.

Issue I have is with double quote sign existing in string value for column,
when I try to escape it with another double quote ( "" ) for command line clickhouse-client
I got error and insert fails.

When I escape one double quote with backslash ( \" ) then it works but got backslash and quote in entry in column.

What is the proper way to escape double quote in CSV structure like I have ?

Clickhouse server version is 19.11.12

here is example for structures and data:
```
# testdata.csv
749a2c8c-3682-4745-aefe-c21b3164bade,name,""MY COMPANY"" COM
749a2c8c-3682-4745-aefe-c21b3164bade,hash,67FF87AF9E9E4BA9E4C03FAC4A23F21C

# table structure
CREATE TABLE temp.events (`event_id` String, `property_name` String, `property_value` String) ENGINE = MergeTree() PARTITION BY tuple() ORDER BY event_id SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192

#shell script to insert data
cat testdata.csv | clickhouse-client --host=localhost --query='INSERT INTO temp.events (event_id, property_name, property_value) FORMAT CSV'

Code: 117. DB::Exception: Expected end of line: (at row 1)

Row 1:
Column 0,   name: event_id,       type: String, parsed text: "749a2c8c-3682-4745-aefe-c21b3164bade"
Column 1,   name: property_name,  type: String, parsed text: "name"
Column 2,   name: property_value, type: String, parsed text: "<DOUBLE QUOTE><DOUBLE QUOTE>"
ERROR: There is no line feed. "M" found instead.
 It's like your file has more columns than expected.
And if your file have right number of columns, maybe it have unquoted string value with comma.
```
